rule_order: same action-type priority and offer insertion order as RuleBasedActionPlanner on the v2 context reconstructed from public observations; not lexical target order
answer_prior: uniform empirical train response worlds matching public known answers
greedy: probability of having no remaining required acquisition after one question * terminal loss / question cost; ties cheapest then lexical target
multistep: exact expected remaining acquisition cost under train prior, preserving semantic and runtime gates; ties lexical target
stopping: fixed existing gates and semantic certificate; planning optimizes question order only
headroom: evaluator-only exact planning with diagnostic split distribution; compare deterministic quality-preserving baselines; finite random draws are not an expected-cost bound
tuning: none; one fixed protocol; no RL or BC model fitting
efficiency_claim: requires positive paired cost improvement against strong matched-quality baselines; no generalization claim from internal synthetic families
